build_faiss_index_from_embeddings: build a FAISS index by populating embeddings from shard files into a trained index
create_checkpoint_summary: create a CheckpointSummary object to track partial index state during embedding population
run_populate_faiss_index_module: run the PopulateFAISSIndexModule to add embedding shards to a FAISS index with checkpointing support
add_embeddings_to_index_in_chunks: add embeddings to a FAISS index in configurable chunks with optional GPU acceleration and L2 normalization
validate_populated_faiss_index: validate that a populated FAISS index contains the expected number of vectors from the embedding file
